metadata.title: त्रिपुरा में आदिवासी क्यों नाराज़ | Why tribal is unhappy in Tripura
metadata.description:
This week's Tribal Bulletin covers significant developments across tribal communities:
Bru Protest in Tripura: The Bru community stages a protest over the delayed implementation of the 2020 resettlement agreement, demanding swift action to fulfill promises made regarding their rehabilitation and welfare.
Lalduhoma, who heads the Zoram People’s Movement, also backed enforcing President’s Rule for now in the neighbouring state Manipur.
Hemant Soren's Political Strategy in Jharkhand: A deep dive into how Jharkhand's Chief Minister, Hemant Soren, has skillfully countered the BJP's strategies, securing his position and strengthening tribal representation in the state's political narrative.
This edition highlights the ongoing struggles, cultural concerns, and political manoeuvres shaping tribal communities.
